text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our second summer camp has come to a close. Before we return to the academy, I find Fine Motion staring intently at the grounds.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
choice_data_list: If there's still something you need to do, I'll join you.
If there's still something you need to do, I'll join you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's quite all right! I just thought I'd like to etch this sight into my mind.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I never want to forget everything that happened here and the things I learned… and the salty flavor of the beach house's ramen…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
choice_data_list: Shall we have one last meal?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: My final bowl of camp ramen! Let's go at once!
